title: He Owned 2 Pairs of Jeans. He Sent 33 Strangers to College #truestory
description:
#truestory #iowa #carpenter

"How much are we talking about, Dale?"

Dale Schroeder was a carpenter in Iowa who owned two pairs of jeans and a rusty Chevy. When he died, his lawyer found out what he'd saved. It sent 33 small-town kids to college, debt-free.
